title: Migrate GPU node provisioning to unified provisioner module for Private VPC with ASG/Karpenter interoperability
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Replace ad-hoc GPU node provisioning in Private VPC clusters with a single, well-reviewed Terraform module that supports both ASG and Karpenter provisioners, improves upgrade safety, and exposes healthcheck hooks used by the Console. Scope includes module API design, migration plan for existing node groups, in-place driver upgrade strategy, and CI validation for node draining/unschedulable flows. Non-goals: implementing new autoscaling algorithms; this ticket focuses on provisioning, lifecycle hooks, and compatibility layers.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform module (registry-style) that can provision GPU nodegroups for both ASG and Karpenter with a single variable set
Documented migration path for existing clusters (step-by-step Terraform migration plan) with minimal downtime
Canary rollout flow that uses lifecycle hooks + healthcheck endpoints and is exercisable via a test harness
Automated CI tests that validate driver packaging, node cordon/drain, and KV cache warm start behaviour on target instance types
Console shows per-node provisioning health and signals for fallback when a node group fails health checks
comments: 2026-02-12 - Kickoff: initial design doc created, linked below. Decided to support both ASG and Karpenter via provider-specific submodules behind a common interface (instance_profile, taints, node_labels, upgrade_strategy).
2026-02-18 - Engineering design review: PM and Runtime teams requested explicit lifecycle hook for 'pre-drain-csi' to coordinate driver unmounts — added to API contract.
2026-02-25 - Blocker found: NVIDIA driver packaging for our internal AMI variant fails on new instance type (g5x). Filed dependency ENG-52314 and flagged in release notes.
2026-03-02 - Prototype PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/712 - basic module structure + examples for ASG and Karpenter. awaiting infra/security review.

2026-03-05 - Migration dry-run in staging: observed 6% failure rate on cordon+drain due to pod disruption budget conflicts. Mitigation: add 'drain_grace_period' and pre-check for deploy PDBs in the plan step.
2026-03-09 - Ops feedback: require explicit tagging convention for nodepools to allow Console to map billing and SLOs; added 'redwood:nodepool' tag as required field.
2026-03-11 - QA: added end-to-end test that simulates node failure and validates fallback to soft-scaling ASG when Karpenter can't fulfill pods.

2026-03-13 - Today: integrating healthcheck endpoint that reports kernel/driver readiness and kubelet health; finalizing PR checklist before merging to feature branch. Anticipate small follow-up to handle 1-minute cold-start regressions observed on quantized models.
Reviewer notes from PM (Ava James): please ensure release notes call out required IAM permissions for the new module and any changes to instance profiles.
Design comment (SRE - Leo Nguyen): prefer using instance lifecycle hooks (ASG) + DaemonSet-based readiness for Karpenter rather than SSH-based probes for security reasons.
